candidateIdentity.variantName: Simplicity 37 mm white gold, silver guilloché dial, small seconds

sourceChecks.note: The maker's official page was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms Simplicity as the model launched in 2000, with individual pieces in gold, platinum, and rare steel.

The Phillips institutional auction record was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms a Simplicity 37 in 18K white gold with 37 mm case, manual calibre 11, and leather strap, but that lot has a white lacquer dial rather than the candidate's silver guilloché dial. It therefore does not establish facts for the exact candidate variant or a factory reference.
The reviewed market listing supplies the specific 37mm white-gold and silver guilloché configuration, but it is not sufficient to create a manufacturer reference or promote M1 facts.

The Fondation de la Haute Horlogerie profile was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms the 37 mm white-gold Simplicity configuration with silver guilloché centre, manual winding, hours/minutes/small seconds, and sapphire caseback.

The Sotheby's exact auction record was checked on 2026-09-03 and independently confirms a 37 mm white-gold Simplicity with solid silver guilloché centrefield, manual calibre 11, and subsidiary seconds. Its individual movement number 152 is a serial identifier, not a manufacturer reference for the candidate.

additionalVerifiedFacts.note: The exact 37 mm guilloché Simplicity auction record specifies an 18K white-gold case; FHH independently describes this as an offered Simplicity configuration.
The exact auction record specifies a 37 mm diameter, matching the candidate configuration and FHH's 37 mm variant description.
The exact auction record specifies a manual-winding movement.
The exact auction record identifies calibre 11; FHH independently identifies the Simplicity as mechanical manual-winding.
FHH describes the Simplicity configuration with a sapphire caseback.
FHH lists the functions as hours, minutes, and small seconds, with no date display.

rejectedProvisionalFields.reason: The worker supplied a synthetic catalogue label; Philippe Dufour does not publish it as a factory reference.

note: Research-only model review; the 37 mm white-gold silver-guilloché configuration, manual calibre 11, and no-date display are now corroborated by FHH and Sotheby's. No factory reference, price, remaining geometry, weight, accuracy, water resistance, lume, or attachment interface is established.
